name: Raygent Accounts
description: Shows which AI accounts the focused workspace may use (raygent accounts policy), which are rate-limited, picks the account for Claude launches, and switches Orca's active account.

statusBarItems.tooltip: raygent accounts for the focused workspace

settings.title: Pick the account per workspace policy
settings.description: When Orca starts Claude in a workspace that has a raygent policy, launch it under the first allowed account that is not rate-limited. Off: the policy is only shown.
